appDescription.message: Tool factory in the browser: build custom tools, at zero cost per use.

homeSubheader.message: A browser that adapts to you: build custom tools, organize your links, and keep an eye on every page you visit. Pick where to start.

toolsSubheader.message: No subscriptions. Just write what you need.

homeToolsCardDescription.message: Build custom tools by describing what you need.

homeBookmarkletsCardDescription.message: Save links with descriptions, tags, categories, and AI-powered search.

homeNetworkCardDescription.message: Inspect every resource the page loads, including ones hidden from view.

chatViewSubtitle.message: Ask anything about the page you're looking at, or search for information online.

chatEmptyText.message: Ask a question, or pick a suggestion below.

wizardStepBasicsSubtitle.message: A short name and description. This is what you'll see later.

wizardStepChatSubtitle.message: Write or paste the code. We'll test it on the next step.

wizardStepTesterSubtitle.message: We'll run your code for real and tell you if it works.

wizardDescriptionPlaceholder.message: e.g. Extract all links from the current page

wizardTriggerStartDescription.message: Starts right away, before the page finishes loading.

wizardTriggerIdleDescription.message: Waits until the page has fully loaded, e.g. to read its content.

wizardScopeEverywhereDescription.message: Runs on any site you visit.

wizardScopeDomainDescription.message: Runs only where you allow it.

wizardScopeTargetsPlaceholder.message:
One per line, e.g.
example.com
example.com/path

wizardBasicsRequiredError.message: Fill in both the name and the description before continuing.

wizardScopeRequiredError.message: Enter at least one domain or page before continuing.

userScriptsDisabledDescription.message: Open chrome://extensions, find this extension, and turn on "Allow User Scripts" to let your tools run.

wizardTestPassed.message: Test passed: the code ran without errors.

wizardTesterReviewNotice.message: "Passed" only means the code didn't throw an error not that it's safe or that it does exactly what you asked. Take a look at the code before saving it.

llmApiKeyLabel.message: API key (optional not needed for local runtimes like Ollama)

llmTestOk.message: Connection works: the model supports tools.

llmTestErrorHttp.message: The endpoint responded with an error.

llmChatEmpty.message: Describe the tool you want to build.

llmSettingsDescription.message: Connect your own AI model to generate tool code from a description.

llmPrivacyNotice.message: Smootter sends the current page's URL, its title, and when the assistant needs it the page's content to the LLM endpoint you configure here. Nothing is sent anywhere else, and nothing is sent until you use an AI feature.

networkSettingsDescription.message: Filter what gets captured while inspecting the network.

creditsDescription.message: Open source libraries used to build Smootter.

toolsImportError.message: Couldn't import that file check it's a valid tool export.
